fn gcd(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 0)
  requires (b >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (b == 0) then a else gcd(b, (a % b))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (a > 0)) or (result > 0))
  ensures ((not (b > 0)) or (result > 0))
  ensures ((result <= a) or (a == 0))
  ensures ((result <= b) or (b == 0))
  effects pure
  example (gcd(0, 0) == 0)
  example (gcd(0, 1) == 1)
{
  if (b == 0) then a else gcd(b, (a % b))
}

fn solve(a: Int, b: Int, x: Int, y: Int) -> Int
  requires (a > 0)
  requires (b > 0)
  requires (x > 0)
  requires (y > 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((a / (x / gcd(x, y))) <= (b / (y / gcd(x, y)))) then (a / (x / gcd(x, y))) else (b / (y / gcd(x, y)))))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, 0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
